title: LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD never compiled on Zephyr 4.1: 14 errors in never-enabled code (snprintf, K_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, coap_core_metadata drift)
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-at2y (edge-cases review P0 follow-through). First-ever Zephyr build with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD=y (SETTINGS+RPL+EPOCH_PERSIST+CCP16+TIME_SYNC chain enabled, native_sim coap_keys base) fails with 14 errors in coap_slot_coord.c regions untouched by at2y: :1441 implicit snprintf (missing <stdio.h>), :1483 K_MUTEX_INITIALIZER undeclared (host-stub-only macro path), :1711 -Wswitch-enum LICHEN_TIME_SOURCE_NONE unhandled, :1795/1815/1834 struct coap_core_metadata has no member 'attributes' (Zephyr 4.1 coap_service API drift — host test stubs freeze the old API). The host test (tests/coap_slot_claim) compiles this file with stub headers, so nothing ever compiled the Zephyr path. Fix: real includes (stdio.h/kernel.h), exhaustive switch, and update the coap_resource metadata initializers to the 4.1 coap_core_metadata shape (see coap_status.c or other in-tree resources for the current pattern).
close_reason: DONE (worker7). Reproduced all 14 errors on native_sim with Zephyr 4.1.0 via new compile-proof overlay lichen/tests/coap_keys/overlay-slot-coord-proof.conf (enables full depends chain: RPL+EPOCH_PERSIST+CCP16+TIME_SYNC+SETTINGS+SLOT_COORD+RESOURCE on the coap_keys base). Fixes in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_slot_coord.c: (1) stdio.h for snprintf (:1445); (2) coap_link_format.h include — coap_core_metadata is defined there in Zephyr 4.1, resolving all 6 metadata-initializer errors (:1796/:1816/:1835, cascade of undefined type); (3) K_MUTEX_INITIALIZER -> standard K_MUTEX_DEFINE (:1487; public macro exists in neither 3.7 nor 4.1, host stub already defined K_MUTEX_DEFINE); (4) exhaustive time_source switch with explicit LICHEN_TIME_SOURCE_NONE case + ts_str='none' default init (:1714-1720, -Wswitch-enum satisfied, future-enum-proof). New host stub lichen/tests/coap_slot_claim/stub/zephyr/net/coap_link_format.h (byte-faithful struct shape) keeps the host test path compiling. VALIDATION: native_sim coap_keys+SLOT_COORD chain builds clean (zero warnings, -Werror) and 37/37 ztest PASS; coap_slot_claim host cmake test PASS. 3x codereview ALL DELEGATED to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS (in-diff: 0; pre-existing design points spec-adjudicated, not filed), edge-cases PASS (verified include/macro idiom against BOTH pinned v3.7.0 and v4.1.0; overlay depends closure non-vacuous). Zero findings, no new beads. Note: the .c edits landed via bd auto-sync commit 7fdd611a23, overlay+stub in 38fe1afb0b (branch beads-worker-7, merged from main first to pick up at2y mbedTLS migration).
